messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: service=redwood-infer-inference, version=v3.2.1-canary, region=eu-west-1, rollout_id=rl-20260315-01. Monitor window=15m. :rocket:
Priya K: saw a spike in 503s ~30s after canary started. Not huge yet but endpoints routing to canary are showing increased tail latency.
Ben L: confirmed, spike to ~6% 503s for /v1/generate on canary shards. Host-level CPU is normal but there's a lot of blocked goroutines in inference-proxy logs.
Alice M: pasting a snippet from proxy logs:```
2026-03-15T02:12:11Z ERROR inference-proxy upstream read timeout id=abcd1234 model=redwood-v3-quant8 addr=10.2.3.54:8080 latency=5.2s
2026-03-15T02:12:12Z WARN kvcache miss seq=1024
```
Priya K: also seeing a small but reproducible quality regression for the canary model variant — truncated responses for long-context prompts. Not all requests, maybe correlated with timeout/retry path.
Marcus S: metric snapshot: canary error_rate=5.9%, host_oom=false, p95 latency jumped from 120ms -> 1.1s on canary nodes. Non-canary stays stable.
Ben L: rolling back option: flip fflag to route 0% to canary or use kill-switch. I'm going to open the kill flag now.
Ben L: /fflag set route.canary.redwood-infer-inference 0 --reason "503 spike and truncation"
deploy-bot: Feature flag update: route.canary.redwood-infer-inference set to 0 by Ben L. Change propagated to route-planner in 18s.
incident-bot: Paging: oncall escalation for deploy-regression-eu. Severity=SEV2. Affected customers: small subset of EU-hosted tenants.
Priya K: customers impacted are low-volume but interactive apps. We should prepare an incident summary for CS if this stays.
Alice M: I tried a direct curl to the canary model pod and reproduced the truncated output on a 2048-token prompt. Attached request/response example:```
POST /v1/generate
{ "prompt": "<long prompt>..." }
==> response body ends abruptly at token 1024 with no error code.
```
Ben L: I'm going to drain the canary pods from LB and trigger a rollback of the canary deployment to the previous replica set. Steps: 1) scale canary=0 on service router 2) kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-inference-canary --to-revision=41 3) monitor.
Sam (oncall): taking primary. Ben, please confirm when you've scaled down traffic — I'll run the rollback and stay on watch.
Ben L: scaled canary traffic to 0 and cordoned the canary nodes from routing. ACL check in router logs: route update OK.
Sam (oncall): executing rollback:```
kubectl -n canary rollout undo deploy/redwood-inference-canary --to-revision=41
kubectl -n canary rollout status deploy/redwood-inference-canary --watch
```
Sam (oncall): rollback completed, pods stable. Rolling avg error-rate for /v1/generate now back to 0.3% in eu-west.
Marcus S: post-rollback metrics: error_rate=0.4%, p95 latency back to 140ms. No new truncated responses observed on synthetic tests.
Priya K: canary logs show a subtle model-swap at startup where the quantized runtime picked a different kernel path leading to read timeouts under certain sequence lengths. Might be a compilation/kernel mismatch. Tagging eng-runtime.
Alice M: capturing heap/profile and the model variant hash, pushing to S3: s3://redwood-debug/canary/rl-20260315-01/trace-1758674321.tar.gz
Sam (oncall): I'm going to take this to eng-runtime and schedule a patch. Handoff to night oncall in 30m: @Marcus S will be primary. Marcus, you'll get the incident summary and postmortem link.
Marcus S: got it. I'll monitor and notify CS/Prod if anything reappears. Please add customer list and exact request ids to the incident doc.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-20260315-27. Status=Mitigated (traffic reverted). Severity=SEV2. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-20260315-27
Sam (oncall): Summary posted to incident doc: short description, timeline, mitigation steps (fflag kill, rollback), remediation (kernel selection patch + new canary validations), next steps (re-run canary with extended seq-length synthetic tests). Assigning eng-runtime: @Alice M @Ben L.
Priya K: for CS messaging — impacted tenants list in the doc + recommended suggested mitigations for customer engineers (e.g., reduce max-seq as workaround)
Ben L: follow-up: adding a pre-deploy check to validate model kernel paths against a matrix of sequence lengths to catch this next time.
Sam (oncall): handing off monitoring to Marcus S for the night. If error rate climbs >1% or truncation reappears, page me and escalate to eng-runtime. Good job team. :thumbsup:
